articles.title: Altcoins outpace bitcoin as celestia jumps 16%, Warsh silent on interest-rate plans
articles.snippet: Celestia jumped 16%, injective rose 7.7% and layerzero added 7.3% while bitcoin held little changed near $82,100 and Fed Chair Warsh gave no sign on interest rates.

articles.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

articles.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
articles.snippet: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

articles.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
articles.snippet: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
articles.snippet: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds—some 85 times faster.
